body.statement: Using \(\mathscr H_{\mathrm{tree}}\), construct and characterize the optimal finite-order approximation of \(G_{T,c}(P)\) over every compatible collection of nested prefix masses, with a matching second-moment bound for its multinomial factorial statistic and a dual pair of legal subtree priors. Determine the first mixed-prefix correction beyond scalar low-count polynomial approximation and prove that the approximation, variance, and testing scales coincide uniformly in \(n,T,c\), including null prefixes and saturation.
body.justification: This is the exact intermediate-history theorem missing between the fixed-alphabet and birthday-collision endpoints.
body.gap: JiaoVenkatHanWeissman2015 and MaZhuJiaoWainwright2022 lift scalar cell polynomials by independent Poisson factorial moments; nested longitudinal prefix counts obey parent-sum constraints and the target weights depend on those same masses.
body.consumer: A solution supplies the bias and variance certificate needed by a total minimax estimator and a shortest honest interval.
